articles.title: Priority Health Introduces Specialized Cancer Support Programs for Self-Funded Employers
articles.summary: Priority Health has launched new oncology support solutions designed specifically for employers to help manage the escalating costs and complex care associated with cancer treatments. This initiative matters because cancer remains one of the most expensive conditions for self-funded health plans, driving the need for better navigation and clinical oversight. For businesses, this program offers a strategic pathway to improve employee health outcomes while mitigating high-cost specialty drug claims and overall healthcare spend.
